description: Small browser QA benchmark using the controlled LumenShop fixture.

cases.bug_description: Searching for mug does not show the Ceramic Travel Mug, even though it is in the catalog.
cases.expected_behavior: Searching for mug should show the Ceramic Travel Mug regardless of capitalization.

cases.bug_description: Adding the Dot Grid Notebook to the cart adds a different product.
cases.expected_behavior: The cart should contain the Dot Grid Notebook after its Add to cart button is selected.

cases.bug_description: The contact form reports success when sending a message fails.
cases.expected_behavior: The page should show an error if the contact request fails, and success only after a successful response.

cases.bug_description: Searching for Arc fails to show the Arc Desk Lamp.
cases.expected_behavior: Searching for Arc should show the Arc Desk Lamp.

cases.bug_description: The account page fails to show the account details.
cases.expected_behavior: The account page should show account details or a clear account-loading error.

cases.bug_description: Redeeming 100 points reduces the rewards balance by more than 100 points.
cases.expected_behavior: After signing in, redeeming 100 points should reduce the displayed balance by exactly 100 points.
